note: 25 Nov 2026 (the owner: "Could you optimize his weights?", then the card "Go straight to the 35B, cap $40"). After MIT CSAIL's weight-space programming (Nov 2026). Stock Qwen3.6 35B A3B (Bob's default brain) served by Brain Engine with the expert trace and live dials. This PC runs loop-sweep.mjs: 200 practice problems (GSM8K train, never the held-out jobs) find the experts that fire more on looped answers; 100 more score each live dial setting against the brain as built. Nothing is trained, nothing is uploaded, nothing a brain writes is run. The winner comes home as surgery-edits.json, to bake into the weights later (forge/pod/surgery.py) only after the held-out jobs score it. If the brain hardly loops on these problems the sweep stops early (cheap). 25 Nov (the owner: "Why turning them down?"): trials go both ways, the failure experts down (x0.5, 0.7, 0.85), the good-answer experts up (x1.15, 1.3), and both at once, for the top 16 and 64: 22 trials. Caps 5 h / $4 on one A40 or A6000.
